title: 3.2 Power the District
concept: Prim's MST Algorithm (Binary Heap Priority Queue)
objective: Grow a minimum spanning tree from start vertex (0) by repeatedly picking the cheapest crossing edge.
controls: Select cheapest crossing edge to grow tree | [R] Run | [S] Step
start_status: Power all 6 districts from Substation 0 using Prim's algorithm.
hints: Prim's MST total weight on this graph is 3 + 2 + 4 + 1 + 2 = 12.
Only edges crossing from visited vertices to unvisited vertices are valid candidates.
